description: Marketing, sales, operations, finance, HR and general business roles: a small set of large employers' Workday job sites that post generically. Deliberately small - for these roles the discovery arms (Adzuna with its free official key; LinkedIn/Indeed if you opt in) and your own target employers (discover_boards.py) find most of the volume.
